lines.text: No cap, I practiced that move fifty times.
lines.style: Speak fluent, casual General American English to a friend, bragging playfully and very sure of yourself: a confident grin in the voice, a short beat after "No cap,", stress on "cap" and "fifty". Quick and punchy, about two and a half seconds.
Speak English as a confused friend who just heard the word and looks around for a hat: one word, puzzled, rising question intonation, a little slow. About one second.
Speak fluent, natural General American English, clear and friendly, like saying a new slang phrase for a learner: two words, stress on "cap", falling intonation. About one second.
